units.source_text: 回到东京时，过年的门松不知何时已经撤掉，

en.t: When I returned to Tokyo, the New Year pine decorations had somehow already been taken down,

units.source_text: 街上寒风劲吹，看不到一点儿过年的热闹景象。

en.t: and a cold wind blew hard through the streets, with no sign at all of New Year liveliness.

units.source_text: 我马上到先生家去还钱，顺便把香菇也带了去。

en.t: I went at once to Sensei's house to return the money, and took the shiitake mushrooms along as well.

units.source_text: 不说点什么，似乎有点唐突，

en.t: Since it seemed a little abrupt to hand them over without saying anything,

units.source_text: 所以把香菇放在夫人面前时，我特意说明：“这是家母送给你们的。”

en.t: when I set the mushrooms before his wife, I made a point of explaining, “My mother sent these for you.”

units.source_text: 香菇装在一只新点心匣子里，

en.t: The shiitake mushrooms had been put into a new confectionery box,

units.source_text: 夫人很客气地道了谢，起身要去隔壁房间时，顺手拎起了点心匣子，

en.t: and after thanking me very politely, she picked up the box as she rose to go into the next room,

units.source_text: 也许是觉得很轻，惊讶地问道：“这是什么点心呀？”

en.t: perhaps because it felt so light, and asked in surprise, “What kind of sweets are these?”

units.source_text: 和夫人熟悉了之后，就会看到她那非常天真的孩子般的内心。

en.t: Once one became familiar with her, one could see the very innocent, childlike heart within her.

units.source_text: 他们对父亲的病情，关切地问了许多问题。

en.t: They asked many concerned questions about my father's condition.

units.source_text: 先生说：

en.t: Sensei said:

units.source_text: “是啊，从你描述的情况来看，现在还不要紧。

en.t: “Yes, judging from what you have described, it does not seem serious for the moment.

units.source_text: 不过，毕竟是个病，不能不谨慎点。”

en.t: But it is an illness after all, so you must be careful.”

units.source_text: 关于肾病，先生有着许多我不知道的知识。

en.t: Sensei knew many things about kidney disease that I did not know.

units.source_text: “这种病的特点是，虽然得了这个病，本人却感觉不到难受，所以老是不当回事儿。

en.t: “The characteristic of this illness is that even though a person has it, he does not feel unwell, so he keeps taking it lightly.

units.source_text: 我过去认识的一个军官就是这样死的，

en.t: A military officer I once knew died that way,

units.source_text: 他死得特别突然，简直叫人无法相信，

en.t: and his death was so sudden that it was almost impossible to believe,

units.source_text: 睡在旁边的妻子根本就来不及看护。

en.t: and his wife, sleeping beside him, had no time at all to care for him.

units.source_text: 他半夜叫醒妻子，只说有点难受，

en.t: In the middle of the night he woke his wife and only said that he felt a little uncomfortable,

units.source_text: 第二天早上就死了，

en.t: and by the next morning he was dead,

units.source_text: 可是他妻子还以为丈夫在睡觉呢。”

en.t: yet his wife still thought her husband was asleep.”

units.source_text: 一直很乐观的我，马上不安起来。

en.t: I, who had been optimistic until then, suddenly became uneasy.

units.source_text: “家父也会这样吗？

en.t: “Could my father end up like that too?

units.source_text: 说不准吧。”

en.t: I suppose one cannot say he will not.”

units.source_text: “医生怎么说的？”

en.t: “What did the doctor say?”
